description: Defines the Admin_UI_DaySpanField class, a form field component for selecting date ranges in the Revive Adserver admin interface, including methods for setting values, rendering HTML, and handling date logic.

classes.name: Admin_UI_DaySpanField
classes.description: A form field class for selecting date ranges, with preset options and HTML rendering, used in the Revive Adserver admin interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DaySpanField with default or provided selection names and default value.

methods.name: getDefaultSelectionNames
methods.description: Returns an array of default date range options with labels from global strings.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the field value using a preset selection.

methods.name: setValueFromArray
methods.description: Sets the field value based on input array, handling specific date ranges.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the current date span.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the current date span.

methods.name: getDaySpanArray
methods.description: Returns an array with start and end date strings of the span.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs HTML and JavaScript for rendering the date range selection UI.
